events.headline: AI selloff spreads from Wall Street to Asia; Nvidia, Samsung, SK Hynix, TSMC, Kioxia, SoftBank, Tokyo Electron tumble amid AI profitability/ROI doubts
Asian stocks slide as AI selloff deepens; Kospi, Kioxia, Advantest among steepest decliners

Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as President/CEO/director after US government input and Trump pressure (Nov 23); shares' initial ~30% pop has since partly unwound in the broader AI-sector selloff
